blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper presents a dataset of 121,536 ground-reasons pairs across 86,464 rulings of the five civil chambers of the French Court of Cassation (2016-2025). An appeal on points of law cannot itself be appealed and often decides a case for good. Understanding how the Court rules is thus crucial and can help lawyers who draft those appeals. Inside a ruling, every ground of appeal (a distinct legal complaint against the appealed decision) has its own answer from the Court. This answer is called the reasons and it belongs to one of a few doctrinal families. Using a deterministic pipeline, we pair each ground with its reasons and attach the pair to its family, according to the established French taxonomy. We obtain a descriptive grammar of civil cassation that shows which grounds succeed, which legal texts they refer to, and how both evolve over the decade. We release the dataset, the code and an interactive consultation tool.
blocks.zh: 本文提供了法国最高上诉法院五个民事分庭(2016-2025年)86 464项裁决的121 536对地面理由数据集。 就法律问题提出的上诉本身不能上诉,而且往往要对案件作出合理裁决。 了解法院的规则如何因此至关重要,并能帮助起草这些上诉的律师。 在一项裁决中,每项上诉理由(对上诉裁决提出的不同法律申诉)都有法院的答复。 这个答案叫做原因,属于少数学说家庭之一。 根据法国的既定分类法,我们使用一条确定性管道,将每一块地配上其原因,并附着在它的家族中。 我们获得了民事上诉的描述性语法,它表明哪些理由成功,它们所指的哪些法律文本,以及两者在十年中是如何演变的。 我们发布数据集,代码和一个交互式咨询工具.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The French Court of Cassation ( Cour de cassation ) sits at the top of the judiciary, for civil and criminal matters alike. When ruling on an appeal on points of law, it can either reject it or quash the appealed decision. Its ruling is the last recourse possible and, as such, it cannot be appealed. The most common outcome is rejection ( 67.5 % 67.5\% of its civil rulings over 2016--2025). Since late 2021, under the open-data mandate of France’s 2016 Digital Republic Act, Judilibre 2 2 2 courdecassation.fr/acces-rapide-judilibre (the Court’s publication database) gives access to its full decisions. Publication alone, however, does not deliver knowledge of case-law trends: without structure, the relevant information is buried in the mass [ 9 ] . This blind spot matters since legal scholarship documents increasingly complex laws and civil litigation [ 15 , 26 ] . For the specialized bar that drafts the appeals on points of law, choosing the grounds to raise is the strategy (§ 3 ). Our objective is to turn the civil cassation corpus into a structured object that is doctrinally faithful and that can be queried. Such an instrument can inform the choice of grounds and, in the process, show how the Court rules.
blocks.zh: 法国最高上诉法院(Cour de optional)在民事和刑事事务上都处于最高司法级别。 在就法律问题的上诉作出裁决时,法院可以驳回上诉或撤销上诉决定。 其裁决是最后的可能申诉,因此不能上诉。 最常见的结果是驳回(2016-2025年民事裁决的67.5%)。 自2021年末起,根据法国2016年数字共和国法的开放数据授权,Judilibre 2 2 courdecassation.fr/acces-rapide-judilibre(法院出版数据库)允许查阅其全部裁决. 然而,单靠出版并不能提供判例法趋势的知识:没有结构,相关信息就埋藏在质量[9]中. 这一盲点很重要,因为法律奖学金文件越来越复杂,而且民事诉讼越来越复杂[15、26]。 对于根据法律问题起草上诉书的专门律师来说,选择提出理由是战略(第3节)。 我们的目标是将民事上诉书变成一个从理论上讲是忠实的、可以质疑的结构化对象。 这种文书可以说明理由的选择,并在此过程中表明法院如何作出裁决。

blocks.en: A ruling contains several grounds of appeal, i.e. the legal complaints the losing party brings against the appealed decision (§ 3 ). The Court answers each one separately, in its reasons ( motifs , the justification it states). Each answer has its own outcome and an implicit doctrinal family: a legal category long established in French doctrine, which must be inferred from the wording of the ruling.
blocks.zh: 裁决包含若干上诉理由,即败诉方对上诉决定提出的法律申诉(第3节)。 法院根据其理由(动机、理由)分别回答每个问题。 每个答案都有其自身的结果和一个隐含的学说家族:法国学说中早已确立的法律类别,必须从裁决的措辞中推断出来.

blocks.en: In this paper, we contribute a dataset, extracted from Judilibre, as well as a reproducible pipeline to analyze this dataset quantitatively, in the categories of French legal doctrine. (1) We provide 121,536 121{,}536 ground–reasons pairs covering the five civil chambers of the Court of Cassation from 2016 to 2025. The 117,073 pairs whose ground is accepted or rejected are attached to their doctrinal family. An article-level layer records the legal texts the Court relies on. (2) We release the deterministic rule-based method that derives these labels, audited at every stage by legally trained annotators. (3) From these counts, we draw a first descriptive grammar of civil cassation accessible through an interactive tool, as an example of the analyses the dataset makes possible.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提供了从Judilibre提取的数据集,以及从法国法律学说类别中以数量分析这一数据集的可复制管道。 (1) 我们提供121.536 121{、}536对地面理由,涵盖2016年至2025年最高上诉法院的五个民事分庭。 117 073对被接受或被拒绝的夫妇都附属于其理论家庭。 一层条款记录法院依赖的法律文本。 (2) 我们公布以定型规则为基础的方法,得出这些标签,在每个阶段由经过法律培训的注释员审计。 (3) 我们从这些论点中得出了第一个通过互动工具可进入的民事上诉描述语法,作为数据集可能进行的分析的例子。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The most common way to study court decisions computationally is through legal judgment prediction: giving a model the text of a case and letting it predict the outcome [ 10 , 27 , 37 ] , pioneered on the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) [ 1 ] .
The work closest to ours is Sulea et al. [ 35 ] , who classify decisions of the Court of Cassation and report strong performance at predicting the case-level ruling. A ruling of the Court often rejects some grounds and quashes others inside the same decision (§ 7 ), which a single label per case cannot show. We therefore lower the unit of analysis from the ruling to the single ground. For French domestic case law, the existing resources stay at the level of the whole decision: linked first-instance and appellate judgments [ 14 ] and outcome-labeled court of appeal rulings on a single issue [ 36 ] . To our knowledge, no ground-level resource exists for the Court of Cassation.
blocks.zh:
计算研究法院裁决的最常见方法是通过法律判决预测:提供一个案件文本的模型,并让它预测结果[10、27、37],这是欧洲人权法院(ECtHR)的先驱[1]。
与我们最接近的作品是Sulea等人. [35],对最高上诉法院的裁决进行分类,并报告在预测案件一级的裁决方面的有力业绩。 法院的裁决常常拒绝同一裁决(第7节)中的某些理由,并否定其他理由,而每个案件都有一个单一的标签。 因此,我们把分析单位从裁决降到单一理由。 就法国国内判例法而言,现有资源停留在整个裁决的层面上:将一审判决和上诉判决联系起来[14],以及以结果为标志的上诉法院对单一问题的裁决[36]。 据我们所知,最高上诉法院没有地面资源。

blocks.en: A different line of work tries to recover what happens inside a judgment instead of only its final outcome. Rhetorical-role labeling tags each sentence with what it does in the text, for instance in Indian Supreme Court judgments [ 33 , 4 , 28 ] . In our work, rather than segmenting the decision from scratch, we build on the zoning that Judilibre already provides: the division of each ruling into functional zones (§ 4 ). We then link each argument to the passage that responds to it (§ 5.1 ). This pairing of a ground with the Court’s reasons is, in practice, a relational form of argument mining, which detects, types and links the arguments of a decision [ 29 ] , recently revisited with LLMs and few-shot methods [ 38 ] . Related annotation efforts structure civil-law and EU decisions semantically or by interpretative function [ 40 , 24 ] , or annotate ECtHR citations in context and release an exploration tool [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 另一条工作路线试图恢复判决中发生的事情,而不是只恢复其最终结果。 Rhetorical-Role 标记每个句子,标注在文本中的内容,例如印度最高法院的判决[33、4、28]。 在我们的工作中,我们不是将决定从零分开,而是在Judilibre已经提供的分区的基础上发展:将每个裁决分为功能区(§4). 然后,我们将每个论点与相应的段落联系起来(第5.1节)。 这种将理由与法院的理由联系起来的做法实际上是一种辩论的关联形式,它检测、类型和联系了最近与法学硕士和少见方法重新讨论的决定[29]的论点。 相关的注解努力在民法和欧盟的裁决结构上或通过解释性职能[40、24],或在上下文中注解欧洲人权法院的引文,并发布一项探索工具[30]。

blocks.en: Explicit rules are the oldest way of treating legal text by computer [ 34 ] and did not disappear when machine learning arrived [ 12 ] . They remain a preferred first pass on clearly patterned legal text [ 31 ] , including for segmenting court decisions from open legal data [ 19 ] . Rudin [ 32 ] argues that high-stakes settings call for interpretable models rather than explained black boxes. Expert-curated factor lists still outperform LLM-discovered ones for case outcome prediction [ 23 ] . In our system, each outcome points back to a doctrinal family drawn from Boré’s taxonomy [ 5 ] (§ 3 ): a jurist can retrace every decision and disagree on legal terms.
blocks.zh: 明确规则是计算机处理法律文本的最古老的方法[34],在机器学习到达[12]时并没有消失. 它们仍然是首选采用明确模式的法律案文[31],包括将法院裁决从公开的法律数据中分割开来[19]。 Rudin [32] 认为,高分量的设置需要解释模型而不是解释黑盒. 专家确定的因素清单仍然优于LLM的发现,用于案例结果预测[23]。 在我们的体系中,每个结果都指向从Boré’s分类学中抽出的一个学说家族[5](§ 3):一个法学家可以追溯每一个决定,并在法律条件上有分歧.

blocks.en: The reference language model is JuriBERT [ 20 ] , a BERT model pre-trained on legal French including pseudonymized Court of Cassation decisions [ 22 ] , which is the data we work on. On the same court, Charmet et al. [ 11 ] train models to generate the keyword sequences that index the rulings. A final group of studies measures how far one can trust a large language model on legal tasks [ 18 , 25 ] . We build the resource itself with deterministic rules. We use fine-tuned models, JuriBERT among them, as baselines against those rules (§ 6.2 ).
blocks.zh: 参考语言模式是JuriBERT [20],一种BERT模式在法律法语,包括假名的最高法院裁决[22],这是我们研究的数据。 在同一法庭上,Charmet et al. [11] 训练模型生成索引裁决的关键词序列. 最后一组研究衡量人们在多大程度上可以相信大语言模式的法律任务[18,25]. 我们以决定性规则建设资源本身。 我们使用经过微调的模型,其中包括JuriBERT,作为对照这些规则的基线(第6.2节)。

blocks.en: 3 Background: How the Court of Cassation Writes
blocks.zh: 3个 背景情况: 最高法院如何写作

blocks.en: The Court of Cassation is not a third instance since it does not re-try cases nor re-examine the evidence: it reviews whether the law was properly applied by the lower court. A party who has lost before a court of appeal files an appeal on points of law. If the court of appeal erred in law, the decision is quashed by the Court of Cassation and remitted to a different one. A cassation can be total (the whole appealed decision falls) or partial (only part of it is quashed).
blocks.zh: 最高法院不是第三审,因为它不重新审理案件,也不重新审查证据:它审查下级法院是否适当适用法律。 败诉的一方向上诉法院就法律问题提出上诉。 如果上诉法院犯法律错误,最高上诉法院将撤销裁决,并退回另一法院。 撤销原判可以是完全的(整个上诉决定落下)或部分的(只有部分撤销)。

blocks.en: Rulings follow a near-fixed sequence of functional zones (Figure 1 ). In October 2019, the Court adopted a direct-style drafting [ 17 ] . Now, the reasons start with « Réponse de la Cour » [The Court’s reasons], while before they opened with « Attendu que » [Whereas]. When a ground succeeds, the reasoning usually starts with a visa (« Vu l’article …» [Having regard to article …]). This is the legal footing which lists the texts the Court relies on. Grounds and reasons alternate down the ruling.
blocks.zh: 裁决遵循近乎固定的功能区序列(图1). 2019年10月,本院通过直属式起草[17]. 现在,理由从`Réponse de la Cour'[法院的理由]开始,在以`Attendu que'开张之前。 当一个理由成功时,推理通常从签证开始( " Vu l ' article... " [考虑到第......条]。 这是列出法院所依赖的案文的法律基础。 理由和理由交替裁决。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The zones of a ruling (left, adapted from Civ. 3, 2019, no. 18-12.682) and the pipeline that reads them (right). Only the badged zones are extracted. Highlighted: the matched visa and family marker.
blocks.zh: 图 1:裁决区(左,改编自Civ.3,2019年,第18-12.682期)和解读区(右). 只有警徽区被提取。 突出内容:对应的签证和家庭标记.

blocks.en: Appeals on points of law are drafted by a specialized bar, the avocats aux Conseils , who hold a monopoly on representation before the Court of Cassation (Code of Civil Procedure, hereafter CPC, art. 973). They were 132 in 2025 [ 3 ] . They file a statement of grounds of appeal in which their legal criticisms are presented as a numbered list of grounds (CPC, art. 978). A ground attacks one or several heads of the appealed decision (the precise points the court of appeal decided). Grounds can split further into branches: numbered sub-arguments, a point of law each.
blocks.zh: 关于法律问题的上诉由一个专门的律师,即律师理事会起草,他们垄断在最高上诉法院的代表(《民事诉讼法》,以下简称《刑事诉讼法》,第973条)。 2025年为132人 [3]. 他们提交了一份上诉理由声明,其中他们的法律批评作为理由的编号清单(CPC,第978条)。 地面袭击 上诉裁决的一位或数位头目(上诉法院裁定的确切要点). 地基可以进一步分为分支:编号子参数,每个分法点.

blocks.en: When the Court quashes, doctrine sorts the why into a small set of families. The taxonomy was settled long ago and its canonical modern statement is Boré’s treatise, continuously re-edited since 1980 [ 5 ] and written by two presidents of the Ordre des avocats aux Conseils . The list is deliberately not statutory. Consulted on the draft Code of Civil Procedure, the Conseil d’État (France’s supreme administrative court) advised against an exhaustive enumeration, so that the Court stays, as Boré puts it, master of its own openings [ 5 ] . The criminal openings, by contrast, are fixed by the Code of Criminal Procedure [ 6 ] . Table 1 lists the families as they stand today.
blocks.zh: 当法院推翻时,学说将原因排序为一小撮家庭。 该分类学早在很久以前就已经解决了,它的犬科现代语句是Boré’s dinese,自1980年[5]起不断重新编辑,由Ordre des aavocations aux Councils的两位主席撰写. 名单是故意不合法的。 最高行政法院(法国最高行政法院)就《民事诉讼法》草案进行了协商,建议不要详尽列举,这样,法院就如博雷所说,继续掌握自己的开局。 与此相对照,《刑事诉讼法》确定了刑事开释。 表1列出了目前的家庭情况。

blocks.en: Table 1: The doctrinal families of cassation.
blocks.zh: 表1:上诉的理论家庭。

blocks.en: Rejection has its families too: doctrine [ 5 ] distinguishes the three situations of Table 2 . Boré treats an inoperative ground as a form of inadmissibility, and we report the two together as one family.
blocks.zh: 拒绝也有其家庭:理论[5]区分了表2中的三种情况。 博雷将不起作用的理由视为一种不可接受的形式,我们把两者作为一个家庭一起报告。

blocks.en: Table 2: The rejection families.
blocks.zh: 表2:被拒绝家庭。

blocks.en: 4 Corpus Construction
blocks.zh: 4 公司建筑

blocks.en: Our corpus is made of the rulings of the Court of Cassation. We retrieved it from Judilibre (§ 1 ), accessed through PISTE, the public French API portal. We collected the data once, in May 2026. We retrieved 548,126 548{,}126 decisions over 1947–2026. They contain more than the text of the ruling: procedural metadata (chamber, formation, decision date) and an outcome label (the decision field ) indicating whether the ruling is a cassation, a rejection, or something else. Whether a cassation is total or partial is not in the metadata. We derive it from the operative part (which either quashes the whole decision or lists the quashed heads). Crucially, the section offsets are also available, showing where each functional zone of the decision starts and ends (including the Court’s reasons).
blocks.zh: 我们的委托书是最高上诉法院的裁决。 我们从Judilibre(第1节)检索,通过法国公共API门户网站PISTE访问。 我们在2026年5月收集了一次数据。 我们检索了548,126,548{,} 1947–2026年的126项决定。 它们包含的不仅仅是裁决的文本:程序元数据(分组,形成,决定日期)和一个结果标签(决定字段),表明裁决是否属于翻案,拒绝,或者其他什么. 撤销判决是完全的还是部分的,不在元数据中。 我们源自执行部分(该部分要么推翻整个决定,要么列出被撤销的领导人)。 关键的是,本节还提供抵消部分,说明裁决的每个功能区始末(包括法院的理由)。

blocks.en: The Court of Cassation has five civil chambers and a criminal one (Code of Judicial Organization, hereafter COJ, art. R. 421-3). We focus on the civil chambers (first, second and third civil, commercial, and social). The criminal chamber is excluded: its openings for cassation follow a different logic (§ 3 ) and its procedure differs substantially [ 6 ] . We only keep the rulings that decide an appeal on points of law. Hence, non-judgment decisions, petitions and withdrawals are discarded (the petition filter ). The time period runs from 2016 to 2025. Indeed, coverage of section offsets for cassations jumps from almost none ( 0 0 – 1 % 1\% in 2008–2015) to 91 91 – 100 % 100\% from 2016 on. We obtain 86,464 86{,}464 cassation and rejection rulings. The source decisions are pseudonymized by the Court and we remove residual names before release. Statistics are aggregated by chamber, not by individual judge, as French law prohibits judicial profiling (COJ, art. L. 111-13).
blocks.zh: 最高法院有五个民事分庭和一个刑事分庭(《司法组织法典》,以下简称《法典》,R.421-3条)。 我们侧重于民事庭(第一、第二和第三个民事、商业和社会庭)。 刑事分庭被排除在外:其撤销原判的开审依据的是不同的逻辑(第3条),其程序大不相同[6]。 我们只保留就法律问题上诉的裁决。 因此,不作出裁决的决定、请愿书和撤回书被抛弃(请愿过滤器)。 期间为2016年至2025年. 事实上,从2016年起,上诉部分的涵盖范围从几乎零(0 — — 1% — — 2015年)升至91 — — 100% — — 100%。 我们得到86 464 86{,}464 上诉和驳回裁决。 来文方的裁决被法院假名,我们在释放前删除剩余姓名。 由于法国法律禁止司法定性,因此按分庭而不是个别法官汇总统计数据(《刑法》,L.111-13条)。

blocks.en: 5 Method
blocks.zh: 5 方法

blocks.en: One pair is one ground and the block of the Court’s reasons that answers it. Branches are not counted separately. While the ground is the unit we count, the Court’s reasons are the only text our rules read (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 一对就是一面之地,是法院解释其原因的屏障。 分支不单独计算. 虽然我们所统计的单位是地面,但法院的理由是我们的规则所读的唯一文本(图1)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Pairing Each Ground with the Court’s Reasons
blocks.zh: 5.1 与法院的理由相一致

blocks.en:
The alternating construction of the ruling (§ 3 ) makes the pairing natural. We first align grounds to reasons by position: the i i -th ground pairs with the i i -th block of reasons. Equal counts on both sides indicate that nothing was split or lost. They differ in 14,826 14{,}826 rulings. We use deterministic rules to re-merge split grounds or blocks of reasons and to give lone blocks of reasons a pair of their own. The rules use the drafting conventions, such as ground numbering or opening and closing formulas. After this stage, we reach 121,536 121{,}536 pairs over 86,464 86{,}464 rulings. Roughly 32 % 32\% of pairs carry no ground text anywhere in their ruling. Those are almost all rejections, since in a summary rejection the ground is often sent to an annex instead of being reproduced in the main ruling. In those cases, the pipeline builds a degenerate pair (an empty ground facing a block of reasons), which does not impact classification since only the reasons are read.
A few cassations ( ≈ 1.3 % \approx 1.3\% of the accepted grounds) also come without their ground text, due to joined appeals, grounds the Court raised on its own, or zoning gaps.
blocks.zh:
裁决的交替构建(§3)使配对变得自然. 我们首先按位置来调整理由:i -th地面对和i -th理由块. 双方的等值计算表明,没有任何东西被分割或丢失。 在14,826 14{,}826项裁决中,它们有所不同。 我们使用决定性的规则来重新出现分裂的地块或理由的块块,并给单独的理由块一对自己的. 这些规则使用起草公约,如地面编号或开口和关闭公式。 在这一阶段之后,我们达到了121.536 121{,}536对,超过86 464 86{,}464项裁决。 大约32%的32%的对子在裁决时没有带任何文字。 这些几乎都是拒绝,因为简单地拒绝,理由往往被送交附件,而不是在主要裁决中重复。 在这些情况下,输油管会形成一个退化的对子(一个面临一系列原因的空地),这不会影响分类,因为只读出原因.
由于合并上诉、法院本身提出的理由或分区差距,少数上诉案(占已接受理由的1.3%/约1.3%)也没有任何依据。

blocks.en: 5.2 Classifying the Outcome of Each Ground
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 分类每一方面的结果

blocks.en: Every pair receives one of the six outcomes of Table 3 . Three statuses are linked to the legal substance: accepted (the ground succeeds), rejected (the ground fails), and consequential cassation (a head falls with the head it depended on). The other three are structural only: no-match, out-of-scope and conflict. The status is derived from a fixed list of regular-expression detectors. They first scan the reasons for cassation signals, then run the same text through the separate rejection pipeline. If the reasons match both pipelines and belong to a rejection ruling, the pair is classified as rejected, since no ground succeeds in such a ruling. When the ruling is a cassation (partial or total), we do not force a classification. As a result, 155 155 pairs keep the conflict status. When the reasons match neither pipeline, two filters apply: one for the wording of a consequential cassation, one for the closing “Scope and consequences of the cassation” section, which answers no ground and is treated as out-of-scope. What remains is classified as no-match.
blocks.zh: 每对都得到表3的六个结果之一。 三种地位与法律实质有关:被接受(理由成功)、被拒绝(理由失败)和随之而来的撤销原判(头与它所依赖的头相撞)。 其余三个只是结构上的:不匹配,范围外和冲突. 状态源于常规表达探测器的固定列表. 他们首先扫描翻案信号的原因,然后通过单独的拒绝管道运行相同的文本. 如果理由符合两个管道,属于否决裁决,则该对子被归类为否决,因为此类裁决没有任何依据成功。 当裁决是撤销判决(部分或全部)时,我们不强制进行分类。 因此,155对155对保留了冲突状态. 如果理由不符合两个程序,则适用两个过滤器:一个用于相应撤销判决的措辞,一个用于终结“撤销判决的范围和后果”部分,该部分没有理据,被视为范围外。 遗物被归类为无对称.

blocks.en: Table 3: The six outcome statuses and their distribution over the final corpus.
blocks.zh: 表3: 六个结果状况及其在最后文书中的分布情况。

blocks.en: 5.3 Doctrinal Families: How the Court Quashes, Why It Rejects
blocks.zh: 5.3 家庭医生: 为什么法院拒绝

blocks.en:
The outcome says who wins, which Judilibre already gives at the ruling level (§ 4 ). The doctrinal family says why the Court quashed or refused to quash, which is novel. For the accepted grounds, we follow the doctrinal families of § 3 : we read the Court’s reasons with a grid of 149 regular-expression detectors, applied as a cascade. We start from the most specific verbal marker down to the most residual one (violation of the law). On the rejection side, a second grid of 110 patterns sorts each ground into the three families of § 3 . This assignment is multi-label: a ground can, for instance, be inadmissible in one branch and ill-founded in another. Both grids were written from the canonical formulas of each family, as found in doctrine and in Boré’s treatise [ 5 ] , then refined on the blocks they left unmatched, before the gold annotation.
These labels form a silver set (automatically generated). Section 6 validates them against a hand-annotated gold set.
blocks.zh:
结果说谁赢了,Judilibre已经在执政一级(第4节)给了谁。 学说家说,为什么法院撤消或拒绝撤消,这是新的。 对于公认的理由,我们遵循第3节的理论体系:我们阅读法院的理由,并使用149个常规表达探测器作为级联。 我们从最具体的口头标记到最剩余的标记(违反法律)。 在拒绝方面,第二个由110个图案组成的网格将每一块地分成第3节的三个家族。 这一任务有多种标签:例如,一个理由在一个分支中是不可允许的,而在另一个分支中则是没有根据的。 两条网格都来自每个家族的犬形公式,如学说和Boré’s discription [5] 中发现的,然后在他们留下的没有匹配的块块上细化,在金币注释之前.
这些标签组成一个银套(自动生成). 第6节用手印的金币来验证。

blocks.en: 5.4 From Grounds to Texts: Article-Level Granularity
blocks.zh: 5.4 从地面到文字: 条级外观

blocks.en: A final stage scans each block of reasons for references to articles and codes. Each reference gives the article’s code and number, whether it is cited in the visa (§ 3 ) or only in the body of the reasons. Each reference inherits its pair’s outcome: an article is accepted when its ground is. The 2016 reform of the law of obligations renumbered the Civil Code. Where possible, we map the old numbering onto the new (e.g. article 1382 ↔ \leftrightarrow 1240).
blocks.zh: 最后阶段扫描每一块引用文章和代码的理由。 每次引用都给出了文章的代码和编号,无论是在签证(§3)中引用还是仅在理由的正文中引用. 每个参考都继承其对子的结果:一篇文章的根据是接受的。 2016年义务法改革重新编号"民法典". 在可能时,我们将旧的编号映射到新编号上(例如第1382条\\\左右翼1240条)。

blocks.en: 6 Validation
blocks.zh: 6 验证

blocks.en: All annotation is blind to the machine labels and performed by annotators with at least five years of legal education each. The structural stages (decision field, petition filter, ground pairing, unusual statuses) are audited by a single annotator. The doctrinal families are doubly annotated: two annotators independently read the same 400 400 grounds ( 200 200 accepted, 200 200 rejected). Their disagreements are adjudicated between them. The adjudicated gold is compared with the machine labels.
blocks.zh: 所有注解都对机器标签视而不见,由注解者进行,每人至少受过五年的法律教育. 结构阶段(决定域,请愿过滤器,地面配对,异常状态)由单一的注释员审计. 理论家庭有双重说明:两名书记员独立阅读同样400 400个理由(200 200个接受,200个被拒绝)。 他们之间的分歧由他们裁决。 裁定金与机器标签作比较。

blocks.en: 6.1 Sampling Design
blocks.zh: 6.1 取样设计

blocks.en: Sample sizes are in Table 5 . Two stages are drawn uniformly, for unbiased estimates: (1) the decision field, drawn before the scope filter and relabeled outcome by outcome, and (2) the pairing, where each ground is checked against the reasons answering it. Targeted draws focus on the error-prone cases: (1) the petition filter (§ 4 ) is audited on decisions worded like petitions, and (2) six pools of 100 cover the four unusual statuses of Table 3 (no-match, conflict, out-of-scope, consequential) and the blocks with no reproduced ground (accepted and summary-rejection, § 5.1 ), plus 20 uniform controls. The family campaign mixes the two regimes: on each side, 50 50 grounds are drawn uniformly and 150 150 are stratified, so that rare families are covered. Aggregate figures are then reweighted to the corpus distribution.
blocks.zh: 样本大小见表5。 为不带偏见的估计,统一划出两个阶段:(1) 在范围过滤前划出的决定领域,并按结果重新标出结果;(2) 配对,根据回答的理由检查每个地面。 有针对性地将注意力集中在容易出错的案件:(1) 请愿过滤器(§ 4)对措辞如请愿书一样的决定进行审计;(2) 6个100个集合,涵盖表3的四个异常状况(不匹配、冲突、范围外、后果)和没有复制地面的块(接受和摘要拒绝,§ 5.1),加上20个统一控制。 家庭运动将两种制度混为一谈:在每一方,统一划定50个理由,分层划分150个理由,从而覆盖稀有家庭。 然后将合计数字重新加权为体积分配。

blocks.en: 6.2 Results by Stage
blocks.zh: 6.2 按阶段分列的结果

blocks.en: Table 5 gathers the figures. Structural stages are reported as percent agreement with the machine label. The pairing audit finds a single pair merging two grounds. Among the unusual statuses, precision goes from 95% (out-of-scope) to 100% where a machine label can be confirmed. The no-match pool is roughly half non-merits material, half real misses of the rules. Table 6 reports the double annotation of the doctrinal families, measured with Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 13 ] . On the sample, per-family κ \kappa ranges from 0.90 to 0.99 (two classes are too rare to measure). After reweighting, all families stay at κ ≥ 0.96 \kappa\geq 0.96 except inadmissibility/inoperativeness, which drops to 0.83: it represents only 6.2% of rejections (§ 7 ). κ \kappa corrects for chance more severely on a rare class, and 9 of the 10 rejection disagreements involve this label. All 17 (10 rejected, 7 accepted) were adjudicated jointly into a gold set, which confirms the machine label on 90.5% of accepted grounds (181/200) and 91.5% of rejected ones (183/200). Table 5 scores all baselines against it.
blocks.zh: 表5汇总了数字。 报告的结构阶段与机器标签一致的百分比。 配对审计发现一对合并两个理由. 在异常状态中,精确度从95%(超出范围)到100%,其中可以确认机器标签. 无竞争的游泳池 大约一半的非优势物质, 一半真正的错失规则。 表6用科恩的“\kappa”表示, 在样本中,每个家庭的ox\kappa介于0.90到0.99之间(两个类别太少,难以衡量). 重新加权后,所有家庭都停留在0.96\kappa\geq 0.96 克,但不可受理/不起作用的情况除外,这种情况降至0.83:它只占拒绝的6.2%(§ 7 )。 \kappa 更严格地纠正了罕见类别中的机会,在10项拒绝异议中,有9项涉及到这个标签。 全部17项(10项被驳回,7项被接受)被联合裁定为一套黄金,其中90.5%的公认理由(181/200)和91.5%的被拒绝理由(183/200)证实了机器标签。 表5对照所有基线进行评分。

blocks.en: Table 4: Validation by stage.
blocks.zh: 表4:按阶段分列的审定。

blocks.en: Table 5: Agreement of the baselines with the held-out gold ( 197 197 accepted, 200 200 rejected).
blocks.zh: 表5: 与持有的黄金商定基线(197 197项接受,200项拒绝)。

blocks.en: Table 6: Double annotation of the doctrinal families.
blocks.zh: 表6:理论家庭的双重注释。

blocks.en:
We want to check whether the released labels are learnable and whether a model beats the rules. We fine-tune the base versions of JuriBERT (§ 2 ) and CamemBERTv2 [ 2 ] to predict the doctrinal families from the silver labels, reading the blocks of reasons. Predictions mirror the dataset’s label structure (§ 5.3 ): single-label over the six main cassation families (Table 1 , without omission and contrariety) for accepted grounds, and multi-label over the three rejection families of Table 2 for rejected ones
(balanced training, learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , effective batch 32 32 , at most four epochs, checkpoint selection on a held-out split). Evaluation uses a held-out gold set of 200 200 rejected and 197 197 accepted grounds: the three accepted grounds whose family lies outside the six the models predict are dropped. Both fine-tuned models beat the rules on rejected grounds and stay below them on accepted ones, the generalist model falling far behind on accepted grounds. A zero-shot LLM (Qwen3-32B [ 39 ] ) is given the annotators’ guideline and their answer options and stays below the rules. JuriBERT errors concentrate on the cases where the gold and the rules already disagree ( 82 % 82\% of them, against 1 1 – 4 % 4\% of the agreement cases). The zero-shot LLM shows a much weaker concentration ( 18 18 – 35 % 35\% against 9 9 – 12 % 12\% of the agreement cases). Trained on silver labels, the fine-tuned models inherit their blind spots.
blocks.zh:
我们要检查所发布的标签是否可学习,以及一个模型是否超越规则. 我们微调了JuriBERT(§2)和ComemBERTv2[2]的基础版本,以从银牌上预测学说家族,解读原因的块. 预测反映了数据集的标签结构(第5.3节):6个主要撤销判决家庭的单一标签(表1,没有遗漏和违反),以及表2三个被拒绝家庭的多标签
(训练平衡,学习率2×10−5 2\times 10×5},有效批次32,最多4个纪元,检查站选择被搁置). 评价采用200 200人被拒绝和197 197人被接受的一套搁置的黄金理由:三个被接受的理由,其家庭位于模型预测的六个之外。 两个经过微调的模型都以被否决的理由击败规则,在被接受的理由上保持低于规则,而通用主义模型在被接受的理由上远远落后. 给注解者准则和答案选项, JuriBERT的错误集中在黄金和规则已经不一致的情况下(其中82%为82 % , 而协议案件中的11 % - 4%为4 % )。 零镜头LLM显示集中度低得多(18 18 — — 35 % — — 35 % — — 9 9 — — 12 % — — 12 % — — 协议案例)。 在银色标签上接受训练,精细的模型继承了他们的盲点.

blocks.en: 7 Results: A Grammar of Civil Cassation
blocks.zh: 页:1 结果:民事上诉法

blocks.en: The 86,464 civil rulings of 2016–2025 split into 28,144 cassations ( 32.5 % 32.5\% ) and 58,320 rejections. The cassations are more often partial than total ( 59.8 % 59.8\% partial). The cassation rate is almost the same across the five chambers, from 31 % 31\% to 36 % 36\% , but its form is not: total cassations dominate only in the second civil chamber ( 58 % 58\% ), against 24 % 24\% in the social chamber (Figure 2 ). The Court also decides each ground on its own, so one ruling can simultaneously accept a ground and reject another. These mixed rulings account for more than one cassation ruling in three ( 38.8 % 38.8\% ). The total/partial divide is about the decision (how much of it falls), not the grounds.
blocks.zh: 2016-2025年的86 464项民事裁决分为28 144项上诉(32.5%为32.5%)和58 320项驳回。 上诉往往是部分的,而不是全部(59.8%为部分)。 5个院的翻案率几乎相同,从31 % 31 %到36 % 36 %36 %,但其形式并非如此:只有第二民事院(58 % 58 %)的翻案总数占多数,而社会院的翻案率为24% 24 %(图2)。 法院还自行决定每项理由,因此一项裁决可以同时接受一项理由,拒绝另一项理由。 这些混合裁决占3项撤销原判(38.8%,38.8%)。 完全/部分的区别在于决定(其中多少落下),而不是理由.

blocks.en: Figure 2: How appeals on points of law resolve, by chamber (2016–2025).
blocks.zh: 图2:关于法律问题的上诉如何解决,按分庭分列(2016-2025年)。

blocks.en: A doctrinal family is attached to 97.9 % 97.9\% of cassation rulings. The distribution across families is highly concentrated (Table 8 ). Violation of the law ( 56.9 % 56.9\% ) and lack of legal basis ( 23.2 % 23.2\% ) amount to 80.1 % 80.1\% of all accepted grounds. The rest is a long tail. Two families of Table 1 are absent in practice: omission (one detected pair, an ultra petita ) and contrariety of judgments (no detected pair). Omissions are repaired by the court that made them (CPC, art. 463) and a successful contrariety ends in an annulment, outside our scope (§ 4 ). The distribution of families varies by chamber (Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 在97.9%的撤销判决中,有一个理论家庭。 家庭的分布高度集中(表8)。 违反法律(56.9% 56.9%)和缺乏法律依据(23.2% 23.2%)占所有公认理由的80.1%。 其余为长尾. 事实上,表1的两个家庭没有参加:漏课(一个检测对子,一个超亲子)和判决(没有检测对子)。 豁免由作出豁免的法院进行修复(《刑事诉讼法》第463条),而成功的反诉则以无效而告终,超出我们的范围(第4条)。 家庭分布因院而异(表8)。

blocks.en: Table 7: Accepted grounds of cassation.
blocks.zh: 表7:接受上诉理由。

blocks.en: Table 8: Family shares within each chamber’s accepted grounds (%).
blocks.zh: 表8:各院认可理由中的家庭份额(%)。

blocks.en: The rejection families are multi-label (§ 5.3 ) and 99.6 % 99.6\% of the rejection rulings are associated with at least one rejection mechanism. Over the 84,460 84{,}460 rejected grounds, the shares overlap and do not add up to one. Overall, summary rejection covers 61.9 % 61.9\% of these grounds, while 38.4 % 38.4\% of them are dismissed on the merits. Rejections for inadmissibility or inoperativeness are fairly rare, at 6.2 % 6.2\% .
blocks.zh: 拒绝家庭有多种标签(第5.3节),99.6%的拒绝裁决至少有一种拒绝机制。 超过84,460 84{,}460被否决的理由,股票重叠,加起来不等于一个. 总体而言,即决驳回占这些理由的61.9%,其中38.4%的38.4%根据案情被驳回。 拒绝不予受理或不予执行的情况相当罕见,为6.2%,为6.2%。

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows that the cassation rate is stable over time, staying around a third over the decade, while partial cassations gain thirteen points (from 53.6 % 53.6\% in 2016 to 66.5 % 66.5\% in 2024). Among the grounds, violation of the law rises and lack of legal basis falls (Figure 3 , left). Scholarship has measured the share of partial cassations for 2017–2021 [ 16 ] , but the upward trend itself has, to our knowledge, not been reported before. The composition of the rejections moves even more (Figure 3 , right). Summary rejection carried 46.4 % 46.4\% of the rejected grounds of 2016 and 73.1 % 73.1\% of those of 2024, a rise of almost twenty-seven points, while rejection on the merits and inadmissibility both decline. The caseload does not explain this rise. The number of rulings falls over the same period, from 9,685 in 2016 to 8,074 in 2024. The Court made explicit in 2020 that it reserves reasoned rejections for cases with normative value [ 21 ] : for the other grounds, the case law only records that they failed. A ground-level count like ours makes visible the extent of that silence, how many grounds it covers and how fast it spreads.
blocks.zh: 图3显示,翻案率随时间推移而稳定,在十年中保持在三分之一左右,部分翻案则获得13分(从2016年的53.6%增至2024年的66.5%)。 其中,违法现象增加,缺乏法律依据(图3,左)。 奖学金衡量了2017-2021年部分上诉的比例[16],但据我们所知,上升趋势本身没有报告过。 拒绝的构成更动(图3,右). 即决驳回的理由占2016年被拒绝理由的46.4%,占2024年被拒绝理由的73.1%,上升了近27个百分点,而就案情而言,驳回和不可受理两者均有所下降。 案件数量并不能解释这一增长的原因。 同期的裁决数量从2016年的9,685宗下降到2024年的8,074宗. 法院在2020年明确表示,对具有规范价值的案件,法院保留合理驳回理由[21]:就其他理由而言,判例法只记录其失败。 象我们这样的地面计数可以显示这种沉默的程度、它覆盖了多少个理由以及它传播的速度。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Yearly shares, 2016–2025: the cassation side (left) and the rejection side (right). 2025 is incomplete.
blocks.zh: 图3:年度股份,2016–2025:翻案一方(左)和否决一方(右). 2025年未完成.

blocks.en: Of all pairs, 74.2 % 74.2\% cite at least one article in their reasons that we can resolve to a code. The summary-rejection blocks almost always cite article 1014 CPC (§ 7 ). The article layer (§ 5.4 ) records, for each text, how often it is cited, accepted, and put in the visa. Table 9 shows three contrasted examples: a substantive text mainly accepted and put in the visa, a contested one, and a procedural lever that is massively cited but almost absent from the visa. The labeled corpus can be browsed through our interactive web application. It shows, for each article, how many blocks of reasons cite it, how their outcomes split, and into which doctrinal families.
blocks.zh: 在所有的对中,74.2%的74.2\%在他们的理由中至少引用了一篇文章,我们可以决定一个代码. 摘要拒绝区块几乎总是引用《刑事诉讼法》第1014条(第7节)。 条款层(第5.4节)记录了每一文本的引用、接受和签证的频率。 表9显示三个不同的例子:一个主要接受并放入签证的实质性案文,一个有争议的案文,以及一个被大量引用但几乎没有签证的程序杠杆。 标签程序可以通过我们的交互式网络应用程序浏览。 它显示,每篇文章都引用了多少个理由,它们的结果如何分裂,以及哪些理论家庭。

blocks.en: Table 9: Three article profiles from the article layer.
blocks.zh: 表9:文章层三个文章简介.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 限制和结论

blocks.en: The main limitation comes from the rules: the doctrinal families are read from canonical wording, so that unusual phrasing escapes the grids. The specific family counts are therefore lower bounds. Violation of the law, last in the cascade (§ 5.3 ), may absorb unusually worded cases of the others. The taxonomies themselves, like any doctrinal systematization, can be discussed [ 7 ] . We follow Boré’s (§ 3 ). Further constraints come from the source. Summary rejections, by nature, do not say why a ground failed. Judilibre zoning, extensive only from 2016 (§ 4 ), sometimes merges several grounds into one (§ 6.2 ). LLM-based segmentation could lift this dependence.
blocks.zh: 主要限制来自规则: 学说家族从 canonical的措辞中读取,这样不寻常的用词就可以逃避网格. 因此,具体的家庭统计较低。 违反法律的行为,最后是在级联中(第5.3节),可能吸收不同寻常的措辞中的其他案件。 分类本身与任何理论系统化一样,可以讨论[7]. 我们跟随Boré’s(§3). 进一步的限制来自来源。 从本质上说,简单拒绝并不说明一个理由为何失败。 Judilibre分区,仅从2016年(§4)开始广泛,有时会将几个理由合并为一个理由(§6.2). 基于LLM的分解可以解除这种依赖性.

blocks.en: The dataset turns the case law of the five civil chambers into a queryable, ground-level resource: 121,536 pairs labeled with their outcomes and 117,073 of them attached to their doctrinal families. Two families make up 80 % 80\% of the accepted grounds, summary rejection keeps rising, and cassations become steadily more partial. The grids are specific to French civil law: future work includes rewriting them for the criminal chamber. The Court’s own open-data report calls for systematic and exhaustive studies of case law [ 8 ] . We release ours: the dataset, the code and the tool.
blocks.zh: 数据集将五个民事庭的判例法转化为可查询的地面资源:121 536对与结果挂钩,其中117 073对附属于其理论家庭。 两个家庭占公认理由的80%,即决驳回率不断上升,上诉越来越偏颇。 网格是法国民法特有的:今后的工作包括为刑事庭改写网格. 法院自己的公开数据报告要求对判例法进行系统和详尽的研究[8]。 我们发布我们的:数据集,代码和工具.
